fns.desc: dpp_ecdh(...,auth->Nx,&secret_len) writes the computed ECDH shared-secret length into local var secret_len, which is then never copied into auth->secret_len before auth->secret_len is read at lines 488/489/491 (stale value from the earlier Mx derivation reused instead). Currently benign because both derivations use the same curve (fixed x-coordinate length), so not exploitable, but the local secret_len output is effectively a dead store and a latent bug if a mixed-curve path is ever introduced.
